denial.denialLetterText:
Molina Healthcare
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: April 15, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 99214 (Office visit, established patient, level 4)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: CO29 — The time limit for filing has expired

PAYER STATEMENT: The claim was not filed within the required timely filing limit of 90 days from the date of service.

PROCEDURE: 99214 — Office visit, established patient, level 4
DIAGNOSIS: E11.9 — Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications

APPEAL RIGHTS: You have the right to appeal this denial within 120 days.

APPEAL DEADLINE: August 13, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
Molina Healthcare
